label: Help Topics…
title: Help Topics
text:
Help Topics

Use the hand tool to edit text, or select a frame/drawing tool and drag on the page. The arrow tool moves objects; its corner handle resizes them. Shift-click selects more than one object.

The rotation tool rotates objects by dragging. The linking tool connects two ordinary text frames; overflowing text flows to the second. F2 opens the complete story. Unlink disconnects a chain.

Insert → Page adds pages. Format → Object changes dimensions, color and text columns. Format → Document changes margins and columns. Right-click text for browser spelling suggestions.

Ctrl+1…5 selects the first five tools. F5 fits the page; F6/F7/F8 select 50/100/200% zoom. F9 toggles snapping.

Close

label: About inpage.net…
title: About inpage.net
text:
About inpage.net

inpage.net 0.2 — independent Urdu publishing editor

Unicode text, manual pages, drawing objects, linked text frames, tables, picture frames, typography controls, index/contents generation and local document files.

Uses Noto Nastaliq Urdu. The installed Noori/Lahori legacy font encoding and native .inp format are still under development. Kashida controls currently insert Unicode elongation characters; they do not reproduce InPage's font-specific shaping.

Browser pagination, typography, spell checking and some window behavior differ from the installed InPage application.

Close
